[[File:Profane Scabarite icon.png|left]]
'''Profane Scabarites''' are [[Slayer monsters]] located in the [[Scabarite Cavern]] in the [[Kharidian Desert]], north-west of [[Pollnivneach]]. They are former followers of [[Scabaras]], having abandoned their beliefs and now causing problems for people in the desert. They also appear as [[non-player character]]s and [[monster]]s during [[Beneath Scabaras' Sands]].

They require a [[Slayer]] level of 87 or higher in order to be harmed. They will summon a [[Spirit Scarab]] during combat if they are able to hit a player, doing a special animation and saying {{RSChat|Skrrt}} above their heads. They may inflict [[poison]] damage to the players, up to a maximum 1,636 poison damage.

Profane Scabarites can be killed for the [[City Quest]] for "scarabs" but not "scabarites".

They drop the [[spectral lens]], the [[Necromancy]] equivalent of the [[black mask]], [[focus sight]], and [[hexcrest]]. The drop rate for the spectral lens is improved with either the [[Profane Scabarites (Slayer assignment)|Profane Scabarites]] or [[Scabarites (Slayer assignment)|Scabarites Slayer assignment]]. [[Sumona]] can assign both and has a higher weight value for them compared to other [[Slayer masters]], making her the ideal choice to use if seeking these tasks.

A [[Elite Profane Scabarite|stronger version]] of the Profane Scabarites can be found in the [[Temple of Isolation]] after Beneath Scabaras' Sands.

==Locations==
To get to the cave quickly, the [[Slayer cape]] can be used to teleport to Sumona, [[Teleport to house]] and exit to Pollnivneach Portal, [[Pollnivneach tablet]], [[Bandit Camp Teleport]], or [[Bandit Camp lodestone]]. The cave entrance is Southwest of the Pollnivneach portal.

The cave has five clusters of Profane Scabarite spawns, with 3–5 Profane Scabarites each. Cannons can be set up in the cave. Additionally, the south-east cluster can be safespotted from below a nearby ledge.
